description: This is a C source file for unit testing support code in a firmware project using ChibiOS/RT. It includes functions for printing, token management, assertions, thread management, timer control, and a test suite execution harness.

methods.name: test_printn
methods.description: Prints a decimal unsigned number to the console stream.

methods.name: test_print
methods.description: Prints a string message without a newline.

methods.name: test_println
methods.description: Prints a string message with a carriage return and newline.

methods.name: test_emit_token
methods.description: Emits a token into the tokens buffer.

methods.name: _test_fail
methods.description: Marks a test as failed at a specific point.

methods.name: _test_assert
methods.description: Checks a condition and marks failure if false.

methods.name: _test_assert_sequence
methods.description: Verifies that tokens match expected sequence.

methods.name: _test_assert_time_window
methods.description: Checks if current time is within a specified window.

methods.name: test_terminate_threads
methods.description: Sets termination request for all spawned test threads.

methods.name: test_wait_threads
methods.description: Waits for all test threads to complete.

methods.name: test_start_timer
methods.description: Starts a test timer for a specified duration.

methods.name: test_wait_tick
methods.description: Delays until the next system tick.
